business.title: Tell us about your business
business.subtitle: This appears on every invoice and quote you send.
business.name: Business name
business.planHintFull: Sales, purchases, stock and expenses, with GST compliance.
business.planHintSales: Sales with GST compliance. Upgrade any time for purchases and stock.
business.stateHint: Used to decide CGST/SGST vs IGST on your invoices.
business.changeLater: You can change this later in Settings

country.title: Country and currency
country.subtitle: Your country pack decides tax rules, invoice fields and date formats.
country.currencyHint: Every report is presented in this currency. Individual documents can still be raised in another currency.
country.gstPack: {{taxIdLabel}} validation, CGST/SGST/IGST split by place of supply, HSN/SAC codes, e-invoice and e-way bill hooks, and {{country}} invoice formatting.
country.vatPack: {{taxIdLabel}} capture, VAT-compliant invoice layout and local date/number formatting.
country.nonePack: A tax-neutral setup you can configure manually under Settings.

tax.title: Tax registration
tax.subtitle: You can change any of this later under Settings.
tax.registeredHint: Turn this off if you invoice without tax.
tax.stateHint: The first two digits set your home state for CGST/SGST vs IGST.
tax.compositionHint: Turn on if you file under the composition scheme — invoices will not show a tax breakdown.
tax.unregisteredNote: Your invoices will be raised without a tax breakdown. You can register later without losing any history.

numbering.title: Invoice numbering
numbering.subtitle: Finalised numbers are never reused, so pick a format you're happy with.

branches.title: Locations
branches.subtitle: Add a branch or warehouse if you operate from more than one place. You can skip this.
branches.name: Branch name
